summary: BIOXIC round 4 — Focus on new .pb- PlayerBar + removal of placeholder images. Backend: pytest 24/24 pass (unchanged from r3). Frontend PlayerBar FUNCTIONALLY WORKS: cover rotates (.pb.playing class applied, spin-360 anim), equalizer .pb-eq animates, LIVE·n pill visible on desktop, time '0:02 / 3:40' shown, hairline present and grows, play/pause/stop/mute/volume/prev-next-disabled all correct in live mode, share button works. SYNC between hero ASCULTĂ LIVE button and PlayerBar is bidirectional and correct in both directions (verified: pause from PB -> hero shows 'Ascultă live'; play from hero -> PB shows pause icon + aria-label='Pauză'). STOP does NOT auto-restart within 5s (audio.paused=true confirmed). MUTE toggles audio.muted true/false. VOLUME slider sets audio.volume (0.3 confirmed). PREV/NEXT disabled in live mode (correct). Cobweb is a real inline ). Pumpkin has radial mask-image applied (margins topite). FOUND 2 UI ISSUES ON MOBILE 390px described below.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile <=480px, .pb-live pill is hidden by CSS rule `@media (max-width:480px){ .pb-live{ display:none } }` (index.css:275). Spec explicitly requires LIVE pill visible on mobile 375px alongside cover+play. On 390px viewport the pill is NOT rendered. FIX: remove or change the 480px rule so .pb-live stays visible on mobile; the 560px rule already hides vol/eq/share/transport which is correct.

On mobile 390px there is 22px horizontal page overflow (document.scrollWidth=412 vs innerWidth=390). Main offender is the tabs row (data-testid=tab-despre overflows to right=477). Pumpkin decoration also protrudes left (-48px) but that is intentional atmosphere. The tabs row needs flex-wrap or overflow-x containment on mobile to avoid horizontal scroll.

integration_issues.issue: Could NOT verify end-to-end seek because the single available track (same WAV used as live) is also the currently-live track; Piese.jsx:23 uses `isCurrent ? toggle() : playTrack(t)` so clicking the track-card calls toggle() (pause live) instead of playTrack(). Therefore mode stays 'live', [data-testid=player-progress] does NOT get the 'seekable' class and the pb-live badge remains visible. Seek code path (onSeek -> seek(sec) in RadioContext) is correctly guarded by `mode !== 'live'`; the implementation looks correct but is not reachable from UI when there is only one track in catalog and it is the live one. Consider either: (a) force playTrack on card click even if isCurrent (and then clicking again toggles), or (b) seed a second track so seek is testable. Not a hard bug but a reachability gap.

issues: Horizontal scroll of ~22px caused by tabs row (tab-despre). Fix flex layout to wrap/compress tabs on narrow viewports.
LIVE pill hidden on mobile contradicts spec; keep it visible even on 480-wide screens.

action_items: Remove the `.pb-live { display: none }` rule inside @media (max-width:480px) in /app/frontend/src/index.css (line 275) so the LIVE pill stays visible on mobile per spec.
Fix mobile horizontal overflow on home page tabs row (data-testid=tab-despre and siblings). Add overflow-x:auto or wrap on <=480px for the tabs container to eliminate the 22px scroll.

Consider: in Piese.jsx line 23, when the only catalog track IS the live track, pressing the card currently calls toggle() instead of entering track mode. If seek on /piese must be reachable with a single-track catalog, change to always call playTrack(t) (which switches to track mode and enables seek). As a workaround, seed a 2nd track.
critical_code_review_comments: PlayerBar.jsx line 25 share URL hardcodes '/piese' as path; should probably include track slug/id for live sharing.

RadioContext.jsx: onLoaded calls audio.play() unconditionally when status is 'loading' or 'playing' (line 219-222) — this can fight stop() because stop sets status to 'stopped' but a late loadedmetadata event with status still 'loading' from a prior load could resume unexpectedly. In this run stop() held correctly (audio.paused=true after 5.5s), so it works, but the condition is fragile.
index.css @media (max-width:480px).pb-live display:none — contradicts product spec; remove.
Piese.jsx:23 `isCurrent ? toggle() : playTrack(t)` — causes seek functionality to be unreachable when the catalog contains only the currently-live track. UX ambiguous when live track == only track.
